=== Skull King: Three-Card Raids ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, sit clockwise (1 to 2, 2 to 3, 3 to 1). The deck has 25 cards: Green 1-7 (7 cards), Yellow 1-7 (7 cards), Black 1-5 (5 cards), 2 Pirates, 2 Escapes, 1 Mermaid and 1 Skull King. Green, Yellow and Black are suited cards; Pirates, Escapes, the Mermaid and the Skull King are special cards. The game has 9 hands of 3 tricks each (27 tricks in all). Every score starts at 0.

START OF EACH HAND: all 25 cards are shuffled and each player is dealt 3 cards face down; you see only your own cards. The other 16 cards are set aside unseen. All players then bid at the same moment, each secretly choosing a whole number from 0 to 3: the number of tricks they will win this hand. All bids are revealed together once everyone has bid. The first leader of hand h is seat ((h-1) mod 3) + 1: seat 1 leads hands 1, 4 and 7, seat 2 hands 2, 5 and 8, seat 3 hands 3, 6 and 9.

PLAYING A TRICK: the leader plays one card face up, then the next seat clockwise, then the third player. The lead suit is the suit of the first suited card played in the trick; if special cards are played before any suited card, the first suited card that follows sets it; if no suited card is played, there is no lead suit. Once a lead suit exists, a player who holds a card of that suit must play a card of that suit or a special card; a player with no card of that suit may play any card. Special cards may always be played. You are offered only the cards you may legally play.

WINNING A TRICK, checked in order: (1) if the trick has both the Skull King and the Mermaid, the Mermaid wins; (2) otherwise, if it has the Skull King, the Skull King wins; (3) otherwise, if it has a Pirate, the first Pirate played wins; (4) otherwise, if it has the Mermaid, the Mermaid wins; (5) otherwise, if it has any Black card, the highest Black card wins; (6) otherwise, if there is a lead suit, the highest card of the lead suit wins; (7) otherwise (all Escapes), the first card played wins. The trick winner adds 1 to their tricks won this hand and leads the next trick of the hand. Capture bonuses are recorded for the winner: +30 for each Pirate in a trick won by the Skull King, and +40 if the Mermaid wins a trick containing the Skull King. The cards, the winner and any bonus are announced to everyone.

END OF EACH HAND (after the third trick): if you bid 1, 2 or 3 and won exactly that many tricks, you score +20 per trick bid plus your recorded bonuses. If you bid 0 and won 0 tricks, you score +20 plus any recorded bonuses. If you bid 0 but won at least one trick, you score -20 and your bonuses are lost. If you bid 1, 2 or 3 and missed, you score -10 per trick of difference between bid and tricks won, and your bonuses are lost. Scores are announced, and tricks won and bonuses reset to 0 for the next hand.

END OF GAME: after hand 9 (trick 27) the game ends. The highest total score wins; players tied for the highest share the win.
